question: Who among the following is India's first woman to win an Olympic medal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnam Malleshwari**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karnam Malleswari** is a former weightlifter from India.
 
• She earned a **bronze medal** on September 19, 2000, to become the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal.
 
• She got the Arjuna Medal in 1994, the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award, **India's highest athletic honor, and the** civilian Padma Shri award**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4bb6f801fbf303bb25b0edcccf15971fb3ee847cfee601cb872f6954a9ed492.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sakshi Malik is a freestyle wrestler** from India. She earned **a bronze medal in Summer Olympics, **becoming the first Indian female wrestler to do so.
 
• **Pilavullakandi Usha Thekkeraparambil** is a former Indian track & field athlete She has **four Asian gold medals and seven silver medals.**
 
• **P.VSindhu** is a badminton player from India. Sindhu is regarded as one of India's most accomplished athletes,** **Olympic gold medal at the 2019 World Championship.
